test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Machinist) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Match the following sheet designations with their corresponding dimensions (length and width).

designation corresponding dimensions

A) A0 P) 297 × 420

B) A1 Q) 420 × 594

C) A2 R) 594 × 841

D) A3 S) 841 × 1189
solution:
**Concept**

 
• The international standard for paper sizes is ISO 216, which includes the A series.
 
• The base size A0 has an area of 1 m² with a side ratio of 1 : sqrt{2}.
 
• Each subsequent size (A1, A2, A3, etc.) is determined by halving the area of the preceding size across the larger dimension.

**Logic and Dimensions**

According to the standard dimensions (in mm):

 
• **A0:** The largest standard size in this series is 841 times 1189.
 
• **A1:** Obtained by halving the length of A0 (1189/2 approx 594). Dimensions: 594 times 841.
 
• **A2:** Obtained by halving the length of A1 (841/2 approx 420). Dimensions: 420 times 594.
 
• **A3:** Obtained by halving the length of A2 (594/2 = 297). Dimensions: 297 times 420.

**Matching**

Given the list of designations and dimensions:

**A) A0:** Matches with **S)** 841 times 1189

**B) A1:** Matches with **R)** 594 times 841

**C) A2:** Matches with **Q)** 420 times 594

**D) A3:** Matches with **P)** 297 times 420

**Hence, the correct matching is A-S; B-R; C-Q; D-P.**</p
